criteria.description: DNS domain enums expose IsValid methods and validators reject invalid endpoints and zones.
DNSEndpoint DTag coordinates and deterministic UUID v5 IDs are stable for all endpoint families.
DNS control-plane request/status/result kinds and Nostr read-model/audit constants are reserved without reactor wiring.
DNS config defaults to disabled and enabled validation rejects invalid TTL, intervals, zones, backends, and projection zone mappings.
With DNS disabled, DNS-specific config validation does not reject otherwise invalid DNS blocks.
